audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN 5.5/10 understates a 60.84% matchup over 406 games, but the shape of the lane on the page is right: you win early, he owns one window on his first mana item.
audit.why: Overload is a flat 5s base that his other spells reset, and Spell Flux is 3.5s down to 2.5s — he can poke forever but his damage is mana-scaled, so the early window is yours and the item window is his.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] said Ryze 'gains Realm Warp' at level 3, and spikes[1] called it a global roam and 'his TP'.
audit.why: Realm Warp is his ultimate, available at 6, on 180/160/140s, and it opens a portal to a location within 3000 units — not a global and not a teleport.
audit.corrected: whys[2] rewritten onto the level 3 truth (Rune Prison only slows without Flux); spikes[1].text corrected to the portal and its real range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credited Brand with a 'Pillar of Flame stun' and a 'stun/root chain'. Neither exists. It also called Rune Prison a flat 'point-blank root'.
audit.why: Brand's only CC is Sear stunning an already-ablaze target, plus Pyroclasm's brief slow. Rune Prison damages and slows at 615 range and roots ONLY if Spell Flux is already on the target — so the E is the tell, not the W.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E-Q stun package for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): 11s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5 — at 615 range it only slows unless Spell Flux is on you first, so watch for the E, not the W. Spell Flux is 3.5s down to 2.5s and resets Overload — his poke never really stops.

edits.before: Carry through AoE math — no burst mage damages three targets like Brand; your job is the spacing that lets the bounces vote.
edits.after: Carry through AoE math — Ryze's combo hits one target at a time; Blaze on the clump plus Pyroclasm's five bounces outvotes it.

edits.before: Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux at 615 range — the E landing is the warning, not the cage.

edits.before: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt.
edits.after: Conflagration is point-and-click at 625 range — Ryze has to land Spell Flux to set his combo, you just click him and burn.

edits.before: Ryze spends Rune Prison (Root) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Ryze spends Rune Prison on a minion — you own the whole next 11 seconds of the lane.

edits.before: That is Ryze’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Spell Flux comes back every 2.5 seconds — Sear does not.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: Ryze's damage is single-target and mana-scaled — dumping the rotation into a full bar just hands him a free Spell Flux window.

edits.before: Brand still wins trades even as Ryze gains Realm Warp, since his combo damage lags behind.
edits.after: Brand still wins trades at 3 since Rune Prison only slows without Spell Flux on you first.

edits.before: Ryze's early combo needs mana he doesn't have yet, so your Pillar of Flame stun into full combo punishes any Q-E poke attempt while he's still item-starved and cooldown-locked.
edits.after: Ryze's early combo needs mana he doesn't have yet, so Conflagration for the ablaze into a Sear stun punishes any Overload poke while he's still item-starved and cooldown-locked.

edits.before: Realm Warp lets Ryze roam globally, and since his all-in isn't fully online yet you should use this window to shove and follow his TP rather than stand and trade.
edits.after: Realm Warp opens a portal to 3000 units away, and since his all-in isn't fully online yet you should use this window to shove and follow the portal rather than stand and trade.

edits.before: Your raw win rate stays dominant because Ryze needs a long, uninterrupted setup to burst you, and Brand's stun/root chain plus superior teamfight AoE lets you punish him before he ever finishes a full combo.
edits.after: Your raw win rate stays dominant because Ryze needs a long, uninterrupted setup to burst you, and Brand's ablaze-into-Sear stun plus superior teamfight AoE lets you punish him before he ever finishes a full combo.

edits.before: After his mythic-tier mana item Ryze's full combo output spikes hard and can burst you if he lands it clean, so play around vision and don't get caught alone in a side lane. Past that brief window your win rate reasserts itself: Brand's Pillar/Pyroclasm chain crowd-controls him before he finishes his long cast sequence, and in teamfights your AoE burst plus root chain outvalue his single-target burst almost every time.
edits.after: After his first big mana item Ryze's full combo output spikes hard and can burst you if he lands it clean, so play around vision and don't get caught alone in a side lane. Past that brief window your win rate reasserts itself: an ablaze target plus Sear stuns him out of his long cast sequence, and in teamfights your AoE burst and Pyroclasm's slow outvalue his single-target burst almost every time.

edits.before: Punish his low mana pool early with Pillar stun into full trade
edits.after: Punish his low mana pool early with an ablaze Sear stun trade
